title: Predetermined skill tier under the 2025 statewide rule: FY2025 share of hours on >= 3-month-experience job orders x order-level skill-II minus skill-I H-2A cash floor gap, employer x state units, unit + state x FY FE
proposer: merge (triage_credibility N1 + triage_power P3; credibility N3 and power P4 as secondaries)
kill_reason: Conversion, not the reduced form. The size-valid gate MDE (largest over the three shared DGPs; node-period share 0.0656 vs 0.0052, ratio 12.7 > 1.5; state CRV1 size-valid under every shared DGP) is 0.60 in epsilon_cost at pi = 1, i.e. the ITT is precise. At the declared pass-through pi_gate = 0.138 (DOL's IFR RIA projection of 8% of H-2A workers at the Skill II wage / 58.1% of FY2025 hours on >= 3-month orders) the MDE is 4.35 > 1.0. The break-even pi for MDE 1.0 is 0.60; no pi <= 1 reaches 0.5; even the pre-period no-downgrading ceiling (tier-share persistence 0.893) gives 0.67 (flag). The stress run with shared shocks at state x tier half (within-state shocks correlated with the dose, absent from the declared DGPs) has no size-valid method under shared_region_serial and 2.74 at pi = 1 under the pair DGP. Not pooling-eligible. No outcome contrast, first stage, event study or FY2026 offered wage was computed.

rubric_scores.note: The triage merge recorded only totals for this new strategy: credibility N1 17, power P3 18, combined 35 ($S/triage/merged.json); no per-criterion scores exist

estimand: PPML semi-elasticity eta of employer x state certified hours (rq13d) per dollar of the predetermined tier component x_i of the 2025-10-02 H-2A cash-floor change (within state x FY); epsilon_cost = (eta / pi_hat) x C_bar, C_bar = 1.2401 x 16.1527 = 20.031.
primary_outcome: cert_hours_rq13d, employer_id_balanced x state, FY2025 vs FY2026 Q1-Q3, PPML
dose: x_i = T_i - kappa L_i: T_i = FY2025 rq13d hours-weighted mean over orders of 1{WORK_EXPERIENCE_MONTHS >= 3} x (F2_o - F1_o), F_k,o = max over the order's itinerary rows of max(H-2A skill-k cash rate [statewide (b)(1)(i), or the SOC's (b)(1)(ii) rate for non-field SOCs], applicable 2026-01-01 agricultural minimum wage); L_i = mean(F1_o - e_o) partialled out (PPML-weighted within-state slope). Dollars per hour; zero in FY2025. FY2025: 58.1% of hours tier-2 (54.5% exactly 3 months); hours-weighted order gap $2.90; zero-dose states WA, CA, FL, CT, HI, RI.
identifying_assumption: Within a state, employer x state units with higher FY2025 shares of hours on >= 3-month-experience orders (scaled by the order-level skill gap) would have had the same FY2025 -> FY2026 proportional hours growth absent the rule.

conversion.formula: epsilon_cost = (eta / pi_hat) x C_bar; ITT eta x C_bar; epsilon_w = epsilon_cost / 1.2401; bound [eta C_bar, eta C_bar / pi_hat]

cost_ratio_used.rule: certified-hours-weighted FY2025 cost_ratio and FY2026 central_vs_h2a_cash (dose on the H-2A cash floor)

conversion.assumptions: dC = d(H-2A cash floor) (housing adjustment identical across skill levels: verified, max |diff| 4e-15); skill II assigned to >= 3-month orders (IFR preamble example; not numerically stated by OFLC); pi_design from DOL's ex-ante RIA projection, with the pre-period persistence ceiling 0.893 reported. pi not estimated (killed before estimation).

support.basis: Two-period FY2025-FY2026 design frame, PPML weights = FY2020-FY2025 unit mean rq13d hours; residual SD of the PPML-linearized FY2020-FY2025 outcome after unit + state x FY FE. 45,782 employers. Other frames: + dominant-SOC x FY and NAICS-3 x FY FE 0.691 / 15.8 effective states (controls absorb little, unlike A3); former-region x FY 0.827 / 21.7; FY2024 placebo 0.744 / 17.3 (45,316 units); near-threshold (all orders 1-3 months) 0.576 / 12.5, leverage 0.22 (GA); county 0.388 / 19.7 (2,874 counties). File $S/N1/n1_support.csv.

design_mde_by_dgp.note: epsilon_cost at pi_gate = 0.138, central ratio. pi = 1 (ITT): county_serial 0.62 (state CV3J; state CRV1 fails, null upper 0.090), shared 0.60 (state CRV1) under all three. Gate MDE by pi: 0.10 -> 6.0; 0.138 -> 4.35; 0.2 -> 3.0; 0.27 -> 2.22; 0.3 -> 2.0; 0.4 -> 1.5; 0.5 -> 1.2; 0.6 -> 1.0; 0.65 -> 0.92; 0.7 -> 0.86; 0.8 -> 0.75; 0.893 -> 0.67; 1.0 -> 0.60. Stress R2 (node state x tier half): county 0.62, shared_region none size-valid (CV3J null upper 0.092; non-valid MDE 3.4-3.7), pair 2.74 (CV3J), at pi = 1. Lead secondary R3 requested positions: gate 0.77 at pi = 1 (state CV3J; no size-valid method under county_serial), 5.58 at pi_gate. Secondary (a) county R4: no size-valid method under any DGP (CV3J null upper 0.078-0.080; non-valid MDE about 0.7-0.76 at pi = 1). Falsification F1 placebo design R5: 0.66 at pi = 1. Files $S/N1/n1_power_{support,calibration,mde,null,summary,gate}_R{1..5}.csv.

gate_dgp: max over shared DGPs: ish_node_period_share on the PPML-linearized FY2020-FY2025 employer x state hours with unit + state x FY FE, node = state: 0.0656 vs 0.0052 pure unit noise (ratio 12.7 > 1.5)
inference_primary: state_fips_CRV1 (size-valid under every gate DGP in R1; fails under county_serial, where state CV3J passes)
split_detail: No data-driven tuning (3-month threshold set by the rule; dose, sample, windows, FE, tests declared). 49 states would permit the state split (seed 20261102) if needed.
prior_exposure: Track 1 FY2026 Q1-Q3 certified outcomes (alternative_identification_exploration.md section 3); A1 estimates and review (within-state D1 reduced forms incl. employer x state SD5, first stage 0.03, cross-state 0.61, FY2026 offered-wage changes); F1 estimates and review (FY2026 offers vs floors; r02b: 81% of exp = 3 FY2026 hours at the U.S. skill-II rate vs 5% for exp = 0); credibility triage (FY2018-25 hours by experience class; FY2026 positions by FY2025 class; take-up 29% vs 2% keep >= 3 months, 23% vs 7% at U.S. skill II, offers +$0.36-0.54); power triage (FY2025 hours shares by requirement, rough MDEs). This design read only treatment-side and FY2020-FY2025 calibration data; FY2026 experience field read for coverage only.
falsification_result: not_run (killed at design); declared F1 FY2024 placebo, F2 FY2020-24 pre-trend, F3 zero-dose states, F4 gap scaling, F5 near-threshold 1-2 vs 3 months, F6 pre-period growth balance, F7 coding stability (pass at freeze: tier-2 hours share 0.529-0.578 FY2020-25), F8 local D2
pooling_exclusion_reason: design-stage size-valid MDE 4.35 > 1.0 at the declared pass-through (killed at Phase 3)
notes: Scripts N1/01_experience_extract.R (raw WORK_EXPERIENCE_MONTHS extract FY2020-FY2026; coverage: valid on 99.0% of FY2020 cases / 96.5% of hours, 100% FY2021-FY2025, 99.995% of FY2026 Q3 cases; EMP_EXP_NUM_MONTHS exists FY2015-FY2019, unused), 02_dose_support.R, 03_power.R (checks the registry hash). Outputs and logs in $S/N1/. Skill-level verification: 20 CFR 655.120(b)(7) and 90 FR 47914 tie the level to job-order qualifications with examples 'up to 2 months' (I) and '3 months' (II); OFLC's 2025-09-30 and 2025-11-03 announcements give no numeric threshold; an industry FAQ (NABC/Cornell, 2025-10-16) treats 3 months as the threshold and says requirement changes must be explained to OFLC. The housing adjustment is identical across skill levels. Design facts for later work: the reduced form is precise (ITT MDE 0.60) and the dose survives SOC/NAICS controls, so the declared downgrading mechanism (secondary c) or a direct estimate of the assignment response would be the informative uses of this variation; but any cost-elasticity reading needs pi >= 0.6, which the rule's own projection (0.14) and the paper route around the tier make implausible.
